movers.quantum: ~Rs 1,400.00 cr, our arithmetic: 1,26,35,379 shares x Rs 1,108
movers.headline: closes and prices its Qualified Institutional Placement: **1,26,35,379** equity shares at **Rs 1,108** each (a 4.37% discount to the Rs 1,158.58 floor price), for **~Rs 1,400 crore**
secures a **Rs 327.35 cr** (excl. GST), 48-month operations-and-maintenance order from **Vedanta Aluminium Metal** for its coal-fired co-generation power plant at Lanjigarh, Odisha
board approves sale of its Novotel Imagicaa hotel to **Juniper Hotels** for a lumpsum **Rs 248 cr**, via a binding MoU executed in early October
sells 63,787 sq m of idle land at Kathwada, Ahmedabad to a third party for **Rs 73.00 cr**, via a conveyance deed executed today

order_wins: **[Power Mech Projects](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/POWERMECH_19102026123348_DISCLOSURE___1_.pdf)** — Rs 327.35 cr O&M order from Vedanta Aluminium Metal for its Lanjigarh coal-fired co-generation plant (~4.3% of mcap).

**[Larsen & Toubro](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/PAM_19102026101805_PressRelease19102026.pdf)** — secures a Limited Notice to Proceed for the New Tashkent International Airport passenger terminal in Uzbekistan, under an EPC contract awarded earlier (value not disclosed).
**Monarch Surveyors and Engineering Consultants** — Rs 48.10 cr order from West Central Railway (~13.6% of mcap).
**Tara Chand InfraLogistic Solutions** — Rs 45.73 cr of new crane-hiring contracts from BHEL and Adani Power, deploying 80-800 MT cranes across their plants (~12.6% of mcap).

**Dhruv Consultancy Services** — Rs 14.85 cr Letter of Acceptance as Authority Engineer for a Gujarat highway upgrade (NH-754k), an 84-month contract with M/s Mark Procon (~37.4% of mcap, our arithmetic).
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Cemindia Projects** (formerly ITD Cementation India) — closes and prices its QIP at Rs 1,108/share for ~Rs 1,400 cr (our arithmetic).
**Kaya Limited** — receives BSE/NSE in-principle approval for a *proposed* Rs 50 cr preferential issue to Axana Estates LLP and Plutus Investments India; not yet allotted.
equity_allotments: **Imagicaaworld Entertainment** — receives the balance 75% subscription of **Rs 129.45 cr** on its 2,34,82,500 warrants at Rs 73.50, completing full conversion with none outstanding.

**Affle 3i** — allots 17,04,324 equity shares to promoter Affle Holdings on warrant conversion at Rs 1,115.25 each, ~Rs 190 cr (our arithmetic); a further USD 14.99 mn tranche awaits currency conversion before allotment.
**Phantom Digital Effects** — allots 4,00,000 equity shares to its promoter on warrant conversion, Rs 9.88 cr.

**Taylormade Renewables** — allots 2,50,000 shares to promoter Neera Gor on conversion of warrants issued in Sep-2025 (Rs 6.24 cr); separately proposes a *new* preferential issue of up to 14 lakh warrants to promoters (~Rs 9.98 cr), subject to a Nov-18 EGM.

**Marco Cables & Conductors** — board approves a *proposed* preferential issue of up to 63 lakh warrants, aggregating ~Rs 20.13 cr (correcting the baseline's Rs 5.03 cr, which was only the 25% upfront payment); subject to shareholder approval.
**ACS Technologies** — receives listing approval for 49,50,495 equity shares (~Rs 20 cr, our arithmetic) issued to non-promoters on conversion of loans.
**Mangal Credit and Fincorp** — allots 25,00,000 convertible equity warrants on a preferential basis (value not disclosed in the text read).
m_and_a: **Sayaji Industries** — sells idle land at Kathwada, Ahmedabad for Rs 73.00 cr via an executed conveyance deed.
**Imagicaaworld Entertainment** — acquires a 50% stake in Mehsana Next Parks, owner-operator of Shanku's Water Park between Ahmedabad and GIFT City (value not disclosed).

**EPL Limited** — receives Observation Letters with NO adverse observations from both BSE and NSE for its scheme to amalgamate Indovida India into the company; SEBI's October 16 comments (ongoing-litigation disclosure, financials not more than 6 months old, etc.) are on record for the shareholder notice.
**Power Finance Corporation / REC** — both receive No-Objection letters from BSE and NSE for the proposed merger of REC into PFC; still subject to NCLT, shareholder and RBI approval.
**GOCL Corporation** — NCLT orders a shareholders'/unsecured-creditors' meeting (24-Nov) on its proposed merger with Hinduja National Power Corporation (deal value not shown in the filing text read).
**CL Educate** — board approves amalgamating wholly-owned subsidiary DEXIT Global into itself; an internal restructuring, no shares issued or valuation required.

**Mid East Portfolio Management** — signs a non-binding MoU for a *proposed* funding arrangement of up to Rs 5 cr with Cher Lifestyle, to fund three new branches; subject to due diligence and definitive agreements.
**Dhampur Bio Organics** — executes Technology Licensing Agreements with Planetary SA (terms/value not disclosed in the text read).
capex_core: **Allied Blenders and Distillers** — commences commercial operations at its Moradabad bottling facility (6 million cases/year), acquired for ~Rs 70 cr and upgraded for ~Rs 40 cr, part of its stated >Rs 600 cr Uttar Pradesh investment.

**Bhansali Engineering Polymers** — pushes back its Rs 200 cr ABS capacity expansion (75,000 to 100,000 TPA) to end-March 2027 from the earlier September 2026 target, citing Gulf War / Russia-Ukraine supply-chain delays to imported equipment.
**Waaree Renewable Technologies** — approves a 35 MWp/25 MWac IPP solar plant at Wardha, Maharashtra (value not disclosed in the filing text read).
**Kwality Pharmaceuticals** — acquires 4 acres of land at Amritsar to build a new injectable and oral-dosage manufacturing facility (value not disclosed; targeted completion Q4 FY28).
**Sahaj Solar Limited** — Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 19, 2026 (filing not read; carried from the baseline).

**Silkflex Polymers (India)** — commences commercial production for in-house manufacturing of textile garment printing inks, part of a capacity expansion (value not disclosed; filing not read in full).
business_updates: **Results season** — 56 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Millworks Technologies** — opens a Centre of Excellence for 3D printing with Markforged Holding Corporation at its Bengaluru facility (no deal value; the Rs 153.40 cr in the baseline is FY26 total income from the filing's own About-the-Company text, not a transaction amount).
**Tata Consultancy Services** — expands its BaNCS for Treasury platform to Indian Bank's Colombo branch in Sri Lanka (value not disclosed).

**Uday Jewellery Industries** — outlines a job-work model using customer-supplied gold and a new lightweight plain-gold jewellery line; corporate supply tie-ups remain at a preliminary, non-binding stage.
**Aeroflex Industries** — granted an Indian patent for automatically generating 3D CAD models of braided hose assemblies.
**Natco Pharma** — announces the launch of Carboplatin Injection (generic of Paraplatin) in the U.S. market.
**Akiko Global Services** — estimated consolidated turnover of Rs 29.60 cr in September 2026, up 71% YoY (Rs 17.34 cr); H1 FY27 turnover Rs 151.57 cr, up 240% YoY (Rs 63.08 cr).
**ACME Solar Holdings** — signs a PPA for a 300 MW / 1,200 MWh assured-peak-supply SECI FDRE project at Rs 6/unit.
distress_risk: **SecUR Credentials** — board approves an appeal to the Securities Appellate Tribunal against the NSE Delisting Committee's October 9 order.
**Dharan Infra-EPC** — NCLT Mumbai pronounces its order (delivered 16-Oct) admitting Tata Capital Housing Finance's Section 7 insolvency petition against the company, triggering CIRP.
**Punj Lloyd** — Integrated Annual Report for FY 2025-26.
**IBL Finance** — withdraws its ongoing NCD public issue, citing UPI/ASBA banking platform failures that restricted investor subscription; says the withdrawal does not affect its financial stability.
**Bilcare** — its wholly-owned US subsidiary, Bilcare Inc, is dissolved effective 9-Sep, voluntary winding-up; not a material subsidiary.
open_offers: **Genomic Valley Biotech Ltd** — PANKAI GROVER open offer for 46.06% (7.94 lakh shares) at Rs 30 vs CMP 32.59 (-7.9%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); **DO NOT TENDER - market pays more than the offer**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 10 cr
credit_rating_changes: **Alpex Solar** — CRISIL upgrades its long-term rating to A-/Stable (from BBB+/Stable) and short-term to A2+ (from A2), with rated bank facilities enhanced to Rs 1,078 cr from Rs 573 cr.
other_notable: ⚑ **Sahaj Solar Limited** — Sahaj Solar Limited has informed the Exchange about Product launch _(⚑ filing content disagrees with the subject tag — held out of movers)_
